source_text: A total of 120 mosquitoes were tested using RLFP-PCR [31] to identify the An. gambiae species and the molecular form of An. gambiae s.s. Of these mosquitoes, 47% were identified as Anopheles arabiensis and 53% as An. gambiae s.s., of which 15% were of the S molecular form and 85% of the M molecular form.
